w10_T4_001496: A swimming school records its fees in whole dollars rather than in cents. Each of the 4 classes held on a Monday brings in 77 dollars, and it all goes into one account. The school ran that same Monday in each of the 5 weeks of the month. The money was then shared equally between the 5 pools in the town, and one pool kept its share. A grant doubled the amount that pool was holding. How many dollars does that pool have?
w10_T4_001497: Ravi's tea garden picks more leaves than Sunil's does. One basket held 129 handfuls of leaves until 96 were spoiled by rain and thrown out. A picker then added 40 handfuls to the same basket. Each picker fills 8 baskets like that in a day, and there are 7 pickers on the slope. The garden works 2 shifts a day, and the estate has 9 slopes worked in exactly the same way. How many handfuls of leaves does the estate gather in a day?
w10_T4_001498: On Monday morning a garden centre had 65 saplings in the polytunnel, and Marta plants more of them than Kwesi does. Before lunch 50 saplings were sold to a park. In the afternoon the nursery delivered enough for the tunnel to hold 9 times as many saplings as were left. The polytunnel is 18 metres long. That evening Kwesi brought in 10 saplings from his own garden, and on Tuesday a grower added 72 more. How many saplings are in the polytunnel now?
w10_T4_001503: A hospital keeps all of its spare blankets in one cupboard. The cupboard held 102 blankets, and 42 were taken to the new wing in October. Another 42 went to the children's ward in November. The laundry then supplied enough for the cupboard to hold 6 times as many blankets as were left. The ward has 24 beds. The blankets were shared equally between the 4 floors, and the trust now wants 5 hospitals with a floor stocked exactly like that one. How many blankets will those 5 floors hold?
w10_T4_001514: Nia blows up more balloons than her cousin Theo does. Nia brought 78 balloons to the party and Theo brought 78 as well. The shop then supplied 4 times that many balloons for the marquee. Half of the balloons were used to decorate the entrance and were carried away. Half of those that remained burst in the heat. How many balloons are still whole?
w10_T4_001519: A fish market records its landings in crates rather than in kilograms, and Ola lands more than Bram does. On Tuesday morning each of the 3 boats brought in 15 crates. At midday a second landing doubled the number of crates on the quay. In the afternoon a trawler added 59 crates. That evening Bram brought in 68 more. How many crates are on the quay now?
w10_T4_001520: A music school counts its violin strings singly rather than in sets. The drawer held 73 strings, and 69 were fitted to instruments before the concert. One more string snapped during the rehearsal. A supplier then delivered 12 strings to the drawer, and 8 were given to a visiting teacher. The school now wants 4 drawers, each holding as many strings as this one. How many strings will the 4 drawers hold?
w10_T4_001524: A council counts its recycling bins one by one rather than by the street. The depot held 202 bins, and a delivery added 72 more. A contractor returned 5 bins and a school sent back 25. During the spring 178 bins were given out to new houses. A neighbouring council then transferred 42 bins to the same depot. How many bins are at the depot now?
w10_T4_001527: A cider brewery keeps all of its bottles in one cellar. The cellar held 109 bottles, and a bottling run added 39 more. The brewery then filled the cellar to 5 times that number for the summer. The bottles were shared equally between the 4 pubs the brewery supplies, and one pub took its share. The brewery was founded in 1902. A cancelled order added 75 bottles to that pub's stock, the chain then ordered 7 times that many for all its houses, and 23 of those were broken in transit. How many bottles arrived safely?
w10_T4_001533: A carpet shop measures its rolls in whole metres rather than in centimetres. A delivery of 167 metres arrived and the supplier then tripled it. A hotel job used 324 metres and a school corridor took another 87. The shop is 20 metres from the station. The chain now wants 9 branches each holding as much carpet as this one. How many metres will the 9 branches hold?
w10_T4_001534: A biscuit factory counts its output in single biscuits rather than in packets. Each tray holds 22 biscuits, and every rack takes 4 trays. The line fills 3 racks in an hour, and those biscuits are shared equally between the 3 packing tables. One table then added 58 biscuits that had been set aside for testing. The factory runs 3 tables like that one on every shift. How many biscuits does a shift produce?
w10_T4_001535: An ambulance station counts its bandages singly rather than by the box, and Ade uses more of them on a shift than Marion does. The store held 98 bandages, and a delivery added 31. A hospital sent 13 more and a charity gave 11. During the winter 88 bandages were used on call-outs. The service now wants 6 stores holding as many bandages as this one, and the region has 3 services set up in exactly the same way. How many bandages will the region hold?
w10_T4_001536: An art class keeps all of its brushes in one jar. The jar held 37 brushes, and 5 of them had lost their bristles and were thrown away. A parent then donated 34 brushes to the same jar. The school ordered enough brushes for the jar to hold 3 times as many as it did. The class meets in room 8. The brushes were then shared equally between the 6 tables in the room. How many brushes went to one table?
w10_T4_001541: A hotel counts its pillows one by one rather than by the room. On Monday morning the linen store held 91 pillows, and a delivery added 80 before lunch. In the afternoon 84 pillows were taken up to the new rooms. That evening the manager ordered enough for the store to hold 4 times as many pillows as were left. On Tuesday a guest room returned 9 pillows to the store. How many pillows are in the linen store now?
w10_T4_001542: Selina's print room turns out more envelopes than Marc's does. The tray held 195 envelopes, and a machine added 4 more. The works then produced 9 times that many envelopes for the mailing. Marc added 37 envelopes he had addressed by hand. The company now needs 6 mailings of exactly that size. How many envelopes will the 6 mailings need?
w10_T4_001547: A council bought 7 crates of laptops for its schools, each crate holding 106 laptops. The supplier then delivered 3 times that many for the whole borough. The laptops were shared equally between the 6 districts, and one district took its share. The borough has 45 schools. That district's allocation was later increased to 3 times its size by a government grant. A charity then added 69 laptops to the district's total. How many laptops does the district have?
w10_T4_001549: Hector's quarry cuts more stone blocks than Rosa's quarry does. His yard took in 9 wagons, each carrying 166 blocks. A second delivery doubled the number of blocks in the yard. A bridge job then used 1854 blocks and a sea wall took another 917. How many blocks are left in the yard?
w10_T4_001552: Delphine's theatre owns more costumes than Ihsan's does. Her wardrobe was stocked with 5 rails holding 232 costumes each. The costumes were shared equally between the 4 productions of the season, and one production took its share. The theatre seats 400 people. That production returned 224 costumes to the hire company, lost 20 in a flood, and sent 29 away to be repaired. How many costumes does that production still have?
w10_T4_001555: Kaia sets more climbing holds than her colleague Ben does. The store held 177 holds, and 127 of them were bolted onto the new wall. A supplier then delivered 53 holds to the same store. A sponsor doubled the number of holds in the store. Ben added 8 holds he had been keeping in his van. How many holds are in the store now?
w10_T4_001556: A market garden records its crop in single cucumbers rather than in kilograms. On Monday morning each of the 3 rows was picked and gave 34 cucumbers. By the afternoon 5 greenhouses had been picked in exactly the same way. That evening a second picking doubled the day's total. The site has 12 water tanks. The cucumbers were then shared equally between the 4 shops the site supplies. How many cucumbers did one shop receive?
w10_T4_001560: A pet shop had 71 sacks of bird seed in the store, and 35 were sold in the first week of winter. A supplier returned 17 sacks that had been ordered by mistake. The shop then took in 8 times as many sacks as it was holding, ready for the cold snap. The shop stays open until 6 o'clock, and half of the sacks are kept in the back room. A wholesaler finally delivered 75 more sacks. How many sacks of bird seed does the shop have now?
w10_T4_001561: A glassworks made 3 batches of window panes, with 158 panes in each batch. An order from a housing site meant the works produced 8 times that many panes. A customer returned 60 panes that were the wrong size. The works has 5 furnaces. A school building then took 453 panes and an office block took 2451. How many panes are left at the works?
w10_T4_001571: Lena's swimming club owns more caps than Bo's club does. The club box held 209 swimming caps, and a supplier added 7 more. A gala used 107 caps, which were given to the swimmers to keep. Bo then donated 47 caps from his own club. The county has now tripled the club's stock for the regional championships. How many caps does the club have?
w10_T4_001582: Ferdi's hardware shop sells more paintbrushes than Anya's shop does. His store took in 7 boxes, each holding 133 brushes. A rep left 45 sample brushes at the shop. A decorating firm bought 354 brushes and a college took another 313. Anya then sent over 58 brushes she could not sell. The chain now wants 6 shops each holding as many brushes as Ferdi's. How many brushes will the 6 shops hold?
w10_T4_001584: A city counts its parking permit money in whole dollars rather than in cents. Each of the 7 districts took 220 dollars in permit fees on Monday, and it all went into one fund. A late payment added 80 dollars, and two successful appeals returned 43 dollars and then another 43 dollars to the fund. The city collected exactly that amount in each of the 4 weeks of the month. A government grant then doubled the fund. How many dollars are in the fund?
